translations.web: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. Yahweh, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
translations.bsb: To the tribe of Levi, however, Moses had given no inheritance. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, just as He had promised them.
translations.kjv: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said
translations.asv: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance: Jehovah, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spake unto them.
